cost.q: How much does a project cost?
cost.a: It depends on what you need. After the free 30-minute call, the paid Plan gives you a written scope and a fixed price before any building starts. The Plan's cost comes off the project.

timeline.a: A basic project is usually ready in 3–5 weeks. Larger ones are split into phases, and every two weeks you get something you can try.

after.a: It's yours, code included, with no monthly fees. If you want ongoing help, Retain covers improvements and support month to month.

language.a: Yes. I work in English and Spanish, from Toronto.
